main_text.p: חַרְחוּר m. Adustio, Inflammatio, Febris ardes.

חָרַשׁ Aravit: Exaravit, Expressit, Impressit, Insculpsit: Fabricavit, Machinatus est: item furdum agere, Obsurdescere, Tacere, Silere. Niphal נֶחֱרַשׁ Arari. Hiphil הֶחֱרִיישׁ Siluit, Obmuuit: Fabricavit. Hithpahel, הִתְחָרֵשׁ Tacuit.
חָרָשׁ m. Faber, Artifex: plur. חֲרָשִׁים.
חָרֵשׁ m. Surdus, Mutus: plur. חֵרָשִׁים.
חֹרֶשׁ m. Virgultum, Sylva: plur. חֳרָשִׁים.

חָשַׁב Cogitavit, Excogitavit, Putavit, Imputavit, Reputavit. Chald. Partic. plur. חֲשִׁבִין Reputantur, Daniel. 4. 23. Niphal נֶחְשַׁב Imputari, Reputari, Aestimari. Pihel חִשֵּׁב Cogitare, Putare, Supputare. Hithpahel הִתְחַשֵּׁב Annumerari.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and dagesh are approximate in places; the scan is faint and water-stained at the lower left. Catchword חשב at foot right.
